long_biography.plain_text:
At Legendary Communities, Taylor helped direct a business that assembled land, constructed houses and sold them across Georgia and the Carolinas. He had earlier studied aviation management at Auburn University, yet became a homebuilding executive. When Meritage Homes acquired Legendary's operations in 2014, he was a key principal in the selling operation and president of Legendary Consulting.

His involvement in housebuilding continued through Trust Homes. He has managed Florida companies bearing the Trust Homes name, while the builder markets new houses across several southeastern states. Trust Homes continues to build in Georgia, Tennessee, South Carolina and Alabama.
